ruleDefinitions.name: Scheduled Task Executed From A Suspicious Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of Scheduled Tasks where the Program being run is located in a suspicious location or it's an unusale program to be run from a Scheduled Task Note: Unmapped fields: Path

sequences.query: (event_id = 129 AND (Path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR Path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR Path = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR Path = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR Path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR Path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))
